checks.detail: All test_stock tests pass. The only error is the test_report import, because inventory.report is WP-02's module and doesn't exist yet.

internal_decisions: Private helpers _normalise and _check_qty validate before any state change.
Unit tests use a FakeInventory double with items() instead of importing the real Inventory.

plan: Baseline: tests (12) and acceptance (8) all pass.
Contracts: low_stock consuming Inventory.items(), including normalised-SKU merging and no mutation. Covered in qa/test_qa_edges.py.
Edge cases: non-string SKUs, None/bool/float/str qty on a new SKU, a 10**30 quantity, removing exactly the stock and then more, and thresholds of 0, negative and empty inventory. All covered.
Errors: ValueError is raised before InsufficientStock, no state changes on a failed call, and InsufficientStock is not a ValueError.
Integration: covered by the contract tests above; the only flow is Inventory to low_stock.
Acceptance: not duplicated; the existing acceptance suite already covers AC-001 to AC-008.
Regression, non-functional: discarded. There is no prior code beyond the version, and nothing in the architecture calls for security or performance checks.
Run again: python3 -m unittest discover -s qa (9 tests, all pass).
gaps: Concurrency and persistence are non-goals in section 2, so they are untested.
SKU normalisation uses Python's str.upper(). Unicode cases such as 'ß' becoming 'SS' are not specified, so I did not test them.
